notes.note: "This treatise carries with it, besides our recommendation, the virtues of being neatly printed, handsomely covered, and moderately price; whilst its size is adapted either for a lady's reticule, or the waistcoat pocket of a a gentleman. It would be well were a copy of the book laid on every card-table, along with the cards; for it may safely be taken as an umpire in all companies, of disupted points."
(with a date of 1828, perhaps referring to the advertisement on page iii rather than the title page)
